Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider.mysql

Class StorageClient

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider.mysql.StorageClient
public class StorageClient extends Object
A typed helper around a `DataSource` that provides convenient get/save/delete/batch operations. Stores payloads as JSON (uses Jackson) in a text column.
